To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the optimal regret rate for the BwK problem is $\Theta(\log T)$, (2) there is a simple, computationally efficient algorithm that achieves optimal regret rate for any BwK problem, and (3) the optimal regret bound is instance-dependent, i.e., the regret bound is a function of the problem instance.

logarithmic regret is impossible for BwK, except when the problem instance is very well behaved.
